label.en: Retreat to the Sphere or prepare for contact

note.zh: 2505：返回探球（2510，从高处观察石质生物）或留在地面准备接触（2515，近距离观察）。
note.en: 2505: retreat to the Sphere (2510, watching the rock creatures from above) or stay on the ground prepared for contact (2515, close observation).

label.en: Stare at the dark star or retreat

note.zh: 2520 的两个选项（继续观测 / 背过身去）都汇入 2535；2530.a 观测黑星（难度 +2）也进入 2535，2530.b 撤离则进入 2540。
note.en: Both options of 2520 (continue observing / turn away) lead to 2535; 2530.a (observe the dark star, difficulty +2) also reaches 2535, while 2530.b (retreat) reaches 2540.

label.en: Black Light Blinded: the leader receives the message

note.zh: 大量星界丝缕；科学家获得特质 leader_trait_spark_of_genius_2（若尚无）与 leader_trait_black_light_blinded；探索结束。2520.b “背过身去”会设置标记 ordered_turn_away，只改变本事件的正文。
note.en: A large astral thread reward; the scientist gains leader_trait_spark_of_genius_2 (if lacking) and leader_trait_black_light_blinded; the exploration ends. 2520.b “Turn away!” sets flag ordered_turn_away, which only changes the text of this event.

note.zh: 大量星界丝缕；该星球获得物理矿藏 d_physics_10；探索结束。
note.en: A large astral thread reward; the planet gains the physics deposit d_physics_10; the exploration ends.

notes.zh: 抽取权重 1，无条件；不产出遗珍，没有失败分支（00_astral_rifts.txt:333-342）。
notes.en: Draw weight 1, no conditions; no relic and no failure branch (00_astral_rifts.txt:333-342).

notes.zh: 2530 可从 2510.b、2515.b 或 2525.a 到达；2525（生物地理学）给一项生物研究选项但使后续难度 +2。
notes.en: 2530 is reached from 2510.b, 2515.b or 2525.a; 2525 (Bio-Geology) gives a biology research option but raises later difficulty by 2.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 2500–2540 全部事件、标记 ordered_turn_away 与难度修正。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 2500–2540, the flag ordered_turn_away and the difficulty modifiers.
